description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableSubjects' implementing the 'Subjects' interface, managing a collection of 'Subject' objects with JSON serialization/deserialization, and methods for adding, removing, and retrieving subjects.

classes.name: ImmutableSubjects
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Subjects interface, managing a collection of Subject objects with JSON serialization/deserialization and collection manipulation methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableSubjects instance from an iterable collection of Subject objects, ensuring unique SubjectIds.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableSubjects instance from a JSON object, parsing Subject entries.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Retrieves a Subject by its SubjectId, returning an Optional.

methods.name: setSubject
methods.description: Returns a new Subjects instance with the specified Subject added or replaced.

methods.name: removeSubject
methods.description: Returns a new Subjects instance with the specified SubjectId removed.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no subjects.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Subjects collection to a JSON object with optional filtering.
